question: How is a half-image constituted in relation to materials and form?
premises: A half-image involves plaster and other materials.
It resembles a full-image only in part.
This distinguishes it from a full-image.
inference: A half-image is made with plaster and other materials and is only partly like a full-image.
uncertainties: The exact technical contrast between sudhayā and anyaiḥ is not fully specified.
plain_english: A half-image, however, is made with plaster and other materials, being half like a full-image.
